title: Refactor proto_check_field_name().
description:
Return a boolean and an error message instead of the invalid
char. That's what users of this API really need. Add a thorough
catalog of error messages.

Remove unused plane from internal ASCII conformance table.
Rename to proto_check_filter_name() because that is more precise,
if we assume "field" and "protocol" mean different things, and
also try to minimize whatever distinction there may be.

Change clients to use the refactored API.

Does not change check_valid_heur_name_or_fail() because enforcing
lower case names there seems legit.
